items.quote: In order to verify the impurities content on the starting materials, inductively coupled plasma spectrometry (ICP-MS, Thermo Scientific, model ELEMENT 2) was used.
The temperature was monitored by a calibrated two-channel pyrometer (IMPAC ISR-900).

In the present work, four samples were made starting from mixture of metallic U (CEA supply), metallic Zr (Goodfellow, purity 99.8%) and ZrO2 powder (Goodfellow, purity 99.9%). Starting materials were directly mixed in W-Knudsen cells under Ar atmosphere.
